status: Original choreography r2 WIP; revised from Elara r1 feedback; Elara re-review pending
rotation_order: Rx @ Ry @ Rz in camera coordinates
interpolation: Piecewise quintic smootherstep between beat poses; sampled at native 60 fps with derivative-matched cubic Bezier root handles. Exact zero derivative at clip endpoints.
source_evidence: The supplied locomotion videos contain no usable first-person jump sequence. These beat poses and timings are original artistic choices, not reference measurements.
camera_motion: None. Gameplay supplies the world jump arc and existing camera landing_kick. Only the held rig moves relative to the unchanged review camera.

jump_takeoff_r2.purpose: Stronger compact downward takeoff inertia and muzzle dip, controlled rebound, exact ready recovery; r1 phase beats retained

jump_air_r2.purpose: Identical ready endpoints; statically hold or repeat for any remaining flight time, without bob or a baked world arc

jump_land_r2.purpose: More readable ground-contact compression using downward inertia and increased muzzle pitch, restrained rebound, exact ready settle; r1 phase beats retained

runtime_contract.trigger: Accepted normal jump only; exclude mantle and stance-to-stand or rejected Space input
runtime_contract.transition: Takeoff then extendable quiet air; landing starts from real ground contact, not the nominal 0.6245-second flat-flight timer
runtime_contract.short_flight: Integration owner must blend an interrupted takeoff into ground-contact landing without a snap
runtime_contract.grounded_camera_kick: Preserve existing game camera behavior; do not add any new camera motion from these clips
runtime_contract.ADS: The source Actions are absolute HIP poses. ADS needs aim-safe viewmodel-relative composition on the separate existing ADS base; do not replace its articulation or clear ADS intent
runtime_contract.gameplay_authority: No input, movement, firing, reload, ADS or mantle behavior is modified by this source package

feedback.requested_change: Keep exact phase beats, quiet extendable air and three-Action split; strengthen held-rig takeoff and landing extrema for clearly readable jump weight in the fixed camera
feedback.changes: Increase downward inertia and muzzle pitch; keep lateral/roll accents and timing unchanged, limit extra backward displacement to avoid needless framing loss, modestly strengthen rebound

revision_rationale.note: Not a uniform scale: added pitch lowers the forward muzzle while keeping the rear receiver readable; landing backward shift stays unchanged. These are original artistic choices in response to reviewer feedback, not a reference-match claim.
